intent: Bring python_pkg/wsg_grabber/player.py under the 250-line file cap by separating the stateless mpv wire protocol and the Player interface from the class that owns the process and socket.
scope: Non-goal: no behaviour change, no test changes, no change to the mpv command line
changes: Moved the stateless wire protocol into _mpv_ipc.py: read_reply (was _read_reply), build_argv, encode, note_errors, plus probe_properties and query lifted out of MpvPlayer.probe/_query, which only ever needed the socket path.
Moved the Player Protocol into _player_api.py; ui.py depends on the interface, not on MpvPlayer.
Moved the probe constants _PROBE_ID, _PROBE_TIMEOUT_S and _PROBE_PROPERTIES verbatim alongside the code that reads them.
player.py re-exports Player, build_argv and encode through __all__.
MpvPlayer._note_errors is kept as a thin bound delegate to _mpv_ipc.note_errors, because test_player.py calls it on the instance and the tests are out of scope for this refactor.

verification.evidence: 277 passed in 15.14s. _mpv_ipc.py 51 stmts / 14 branches 100%, _player_api.py 100%, player.py 89 stmts 100%. An intermediate version of this split failed with 1 failed / 276 passed because test_mpv_errors_are_logged_rather_than_discarded calls mpv._note_errors as a bound method; the delegate was added in response to that real failure, not pre-emptively.
Only the expected 'no staged evidence artifact' failure remained, which this file satisfies. ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit and the coverage-gated pytest all pass with no suppression.

risks: _PROBE_ID is 9001 and read_reply matches replies on it. An intermediate version of the new module briefly carried a placeholder value of 1, which would have made every probe hang until timeout while still returning a plausible-looking error string; the constants were then moved across verbatim and the value re-checked at 9001.
probe_properties/query now take an ipc_path rather than reading self._ipc_path. MpvPlayer.probe delegates, so the public behaviour is unchanged and the tests that drive mpv.probe() cover both.
rollback: git revert the commit; player.py returns to its 373-line form and the two new modules are deleted.
After rollback, run python3 -m pytest python_pkg/wsg_grabber/tests/ -q to confirm 277 tests still pass.
